title: Flight Deck Information Displays — System Description

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew description of the flight deck information displays, covering log-in, what is available on each side, the behaviour on ground power and the screen dimming that precedes an unavailability.

sections.purpose: Describes for the flight crew the flight deck information displays, their availability on each side, and the indications that precede a loss of the display.
sections.description: Each pilot has an information display mounted on a swinging arm at the side console. The display gives performance calculation, charts and the operating documentation, and each pilot logs in to it individually. On aircraft with the current installation the display is powered only when a crew member is logged in while the aircraft is on ground power, which means a display that is dark on arrival at the aircraft is normal and not a defect. The display reduces its illumination in steps when the enclosure approaches its temperature limit, which the crew will notice as a screen that becomes progressively harder to read on a hot stand with the sun on the windscreen. That behaviour is deliberate and is intended to keep the display available rather than let it shut down. Where the display does become unavailable it will restore itself once the flight deck has cooled. The display is not required equipment and the performance calculation may be completed by the alternative means in the operations manual.
sections.crew_procedure: Log in to the display on arrival at the aircraft; a dark display on ground power is normal until a crew member logs in. If the display becomes progressively dimmer on a hot stand, position the arm away from the windscreen and continue; the display is protecting itself and will recover. If the display becomes unavailable, use the alternative means for the performance calculation given in the operations manual and do not delay the departure waiting for it to return. Record the occurrence in the technical log with the outside air temperature.

type_data.crew_action: Log in on arrival; use the alternative means if the display is unavailable.
